title: Around the Air Force: Recruiter Health Care, Better EOD Robots, Ejection Seat Testing
description: This week's look around the Air Force highlights an effort to provide better healthcare solutions for recruiters in remote locations, an upgrade to explosive ordnance disposal robots, and testing of a new ejection seat configuration for the new T-7A trainer aircraft.
keywords: recruiters, ATAF, aftv, T-7A, EOD, Healthcare
